title: PoisonForge: Task-Level Targeted Poisoning Benchmark for Instruction-Tuned LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model vulnerability to task-level data poisoning by measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) and Spillover Rate (SOR) using regex matching to detect whether attacker-specified target entities (which the authors parameterize as "bias types" such as years, animals, locations, and names) are embedded in generated outputs for specific targeted tasks.
